name: Supporting Document Request Or Letter 4
definition: Currency control related document or letter supporting the contract registration.

RequestOrLetterIdentification.name: Request Or Letter Identification
RequestOrLetterIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the supporting document request or the letter.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date of the supporting document request or the letter.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Sender of the request or letter.

Receiver.name: Receiver
Receiver.definition: Receiver of the request or letter.

OriginalReferences.name: Original References
OriginalReferences.definition: Provides the references of the original underlying message(s) for which supporting documents are requested or for which the letter is sent.

Subject.name: Subject
Subject.definition: Subject of the letter or supporting document.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Provides the type of supporting document requested.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Further free format description of the request.

ResponseRequired.name: Response Required
ResponseRequired.definition: Flag to indicate whether a response is required or not.||Usage: when the request is used to send a letter, there is no response required.

DueDate.name: Due Date
DueDate.definition: Date by which the response to the request is expected.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.definition: Documents provided as attachments to the supporting document request or letter.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
